name: 93280 · Wasco, CA
findings: ZIP 93280 (Wasco) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (80% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93280 (Wasco) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93280 (Wasco) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).
